globalNews.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
globalNews.summary: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

globalNews.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
globalNews.summary: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

globalNews.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
globalNews.summary: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

globalNews.title: At least 169 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
globalNews.summary: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

globalNews.title: Libyan authorities battle big blaze at major oil refinery
globalNews.summary: Monday's drone strike on the Zawiya refinery was the third such incident in two days.

cryptoNews.title: ADI Chain, Shipfinex partner to tokenize $500M vessel pipeline
cryptoNews.summary: Shipfinex plans to bring 35 vessels onchain through ADI Chain as tokenization expands into the multitrillion-dollar maritime industry.

cryptoNews.title: SharpLink reports $394M in Q2 net loss fueled by ETH decline
cryptoNews.summary: SharpLink reported a net loss of $394 million in the second quarter of 2026, largely driven by Ether’s 23% decline during the quarter.

cryptoNews.title: EToro to buy TradeZero as Q2 crypto revenue falls 30%
cryptoNews.summary: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.

cryptoNews.title: Russia proposes exchange trading of Bitcoin, Ether and Tether’s USDT
cryptoNews.summary: Russia’s central bank proposed allowing Bitcoin, Ether and USDT to trade on regulated exchanges, following a law signed by President Vladimir Putin last week.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin sell pressure ‘closer to exhaustion’ after $4B USDT market-cap drop: CryptoQuant
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin analysis suggested that sell pressure would not increase given the historically large contraction in USDT market cap over a 60-day period.

aiNews.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
aiNews.summary: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.

aiNews.title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
aiNews.summary: San Francisco's housing market is in trouble again.

aiNews.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
aiNews.summary: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

aiNews.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
aiNews.summary: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.
